searchText: Today I will repeat the experiment with sending ~80k 1-blob txs from 80k accounts, but this time I will spam in parallel from 8 machines instead of 1, so the whole spamming should be a done a few times faster and network utilization should be higher a few times. I'm finishing preparations, pulling a trigger in a few minutes We have just launched msf-1. https://dencun-msf-1.ethpandaops.io we are aware that all nethermind nodes report to be offline, this most likely do a configuration error. Dencun coming up in a minute. Let us know if there's specific tests we should do.
